evidence_span.text: our observations establish that NRP1 enables CDC42 activation and CDC42-dependent actin dynamics and filopodia extension in ECM-stimulated ECs, independently of VEGF-A signaling.

reviews.rationale: The paper causally shows Nrp1 (a regulator, not a supplied gene) enables CDC42 activation driving tip-cell filopodia and sprouting, supporting only a narrower form of the cited arm; the supplied gene Cdc42ep3 (a distinct CDC42 effector) is never investigated. Evidence is embryonic hindbrain plus retina/zebrafish/human ECs, a closely related developmental setting for postnatal brain endothelium, so the declared partial context is accurate rather than direct.
